analyst_view.overall: Early view: a relegation game between Real Sociedad B (19th, 11 points) and Leganés (17th, 12 points), who have not won since Luis Carrión took over in October. Leganés have a poor away record (five scored, 14 conceded in seven). Javi Montero's red-card ban should be served long before this one.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals. I lean slightly higher: Leganés concede two a game away, and Real Sociedad B's recent matches have been open (1-4, 2-4 and 2-3 among them).

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners. I found nothing that points clearly either way, so I stay with the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 6.5 cards, already a high figure. Leganés are card-prone (five yellows and a red against Albacete, three players on five yellows), which supports the number rather than pushing it higher.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.8 shots, with 16.9 for Real Sociedad B. I lean lower: the reserve side have scored only six goals in six home games, so that home share looks generous.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 shots on target. I lean slightly lower, mainly because Real Sociedad B's home attack has been weak.
